tool_args.rationale: The added open-branch observation helps, but substrate and gradient remain confounded across only six points. A finer trajectory batch can provide additional information to distinguish smooth interaction mechanisms before numerical fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled subcritical siphon law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Six observations at coupled substrate and gradient values do not establish whether that three-parameter law or a more complex interaction explains the response.
The observed gradient dependence makes a substrate-only Haldane curve inadequate, while the small sample does not reliably distinguish the remaining interaction forms.
The nuisance measurement would not resolve the mechanism.
